name: @tpmjs/official-memory
description: Persistent, semantically-searchable memory tools for AI agents. Create and search memories across sessions.

env.name: TPMJS_API_KEY
env.description: Your TPMJS Platform API key with memory:read and memory:write scopes

env.name: TPMJS_BASE_URL
env.description: TPMJS API base URL (defaults to https://tpmjs.com)

tools.name: createMemoryTool
tools.description: Store a persistent memory that can be retrieved later via semantic search. Use for saving context, decisions, preferences, or any information that should persist across sessions.

tools.name: searchMemoryTool
tools.description: Search memories using natural language semantic search. Returns the most relevant memories ranked by similarity.
